segments.narration: A whole colony vanished and left one word behind. Roanoke Island, fifteen ninety. The word was CROATOAN.
John White had left in fifteen eighty-seven to fetch supplies, including his own daughter and granddaughter Virginia Dare.
War with Spain trapped him in England for three years. When he finally got back the settlement was standing empty and stripped.
The houses had been dismantled, board by board. That is not a raid. That is people packing to move.
White had agreed a code: a cross carved beside the name if they left in danger. There was no cross, and a storm drove him home before he could reach Croatoan.
